understanding.purpose: 记录各版本的发布日期、更新类型和具体变更，供读者查看版本演进。
understanding.reading: 读者可先按版本或日期定位，再扫描类型和变更内容；同一行的元数据与说明需要保持清晰的对应关系。
groups: 版本与日期共同标识一次发布，适合并置比较。
类型与变更内容共同说明更新性质；类型是短标签，内容是主要阅读区域。
keep_intact: 版本号及其字母、数字和标点
WebSocket、OAuth、OpenSSL 等英文术语及版本号
修复、新功能、性能、安全等类型标签宜尽量保持完整
may_wrap: 变更内容可在中文词句及英文术语之间自然换行。
日期可在连字符处换行，但会降低纵向扫描效率。
内容说明形成的行高可容纳同一行中类型或日期的换行。

bad.why: Giving the date a single line leaves the change descriptions narrow and heavily fragmented, making rows much taller and harder to scan.
The date column is narrow enough that some dates break across three lines, disrupting comparison down the column.
The narrower description column adds a line to the longest row without keeping dates on one line or improving the type labels.
The date and type columns consume too much of the viewport, leaving descriptions in a narrow column with up to eight lines per cell.

final.rationale: r3B keeps version identifiers and all type labels on one line while giving the change descriptions enough width to read in manageable blocks. Dates wrap consistently at the year boundary, and the four records remain distinguishable as rows. The nearby r3A is also publishable, but its slightly narrower description column offers no clear compensating benefit.

general: Give narrative columns enough width to preserve readable phrases, especially when they contain mixed scripts and technical identifiers.
Keep short categorical labels intact where a small width increase can prevent wrapping, and assess the resulting allocation across the whole table.
Consistent line breaks in repeated fields support scanning, even when the fields cannot fit on one line.
specific: At this viewport width, keeping every date on one line takes too much space from the change descriptions.
The type column needs about 67 px to keep 新功能 on one line in these renderings.

final.tradeoffs: A designer may prefer r3A's slightly wider date column, or accept wrapped type labels in r1B or r2A to give descriptions more room. Keeping dates on one line is possible, but substantially increases the height and fragmentation of the descriptions.
final.uncertain: The ranges are conservative estimates from the supplied candidates, not independently tested continuous intervals. Individual column limits depend on how the remaining width is redistributed, and small changes can alter browser line breaks.

A.why: 变更内容列过窄，WebSocket 和其他英文内容被拆开，长行大量换行，行高远超过其余各列的需要。

B.why: 变更内容有较多空间，但类型列窄到连表头和所有类型都竖向换行；日期也被拆成两行。

C.why: 变更内容基本可读，但日期全部换行，“新功能”也被拆开，类型列略显局促。

D.why: 类型保持完整，变更内容也有较好的阅读宽度；但每个日期都被拆成两行，削弱了扫描日期的便利。

E.why: 变更内容的宽度较合理，但日期全部换行，“新功能”也被拆开，表格的紧凑感因此受到影响。

F.why: 版本和日期都保持完整，便于快速扫描；变更内容较窄，但仍有可读的行长。“新功能”和末行的 CVE 标识发生换行。

reviews.unsure: D 的变更内容更宽且类型完整，但日期全部换行；F 保留完整日期，代价是变更内容更窄。两者取舍取决于读者更常按日期还是按类型扫描。

A.why: 版本和类型保持完整，变更内容也有较好的阅读宽度；日期都折成两行，稍碍快速比较。

B.why: 日期完整且便于比较，但变更内容较窄，英文术语和句子频繁换行，新功能也被拆开。

C.why: 变更内容的宽度尚可，但日期折行，新功能也被拆成两行，类型列显得偏窄。

D.why: 变更内容有较宽的空间，句子比其他多数方案更连贯；但日期折行，新功能和 --dry-run 被拆开。

E.why: 变更内容较宽，但类型列过窄，连表头和所有类型值都竖向折行，削弱了分类的可读性。

F.why: 变更内容列过窄，WebSocket 等词被拆开，句子形成很长的窄行；其他列却留下大量空白。

reviews.unsure: A 和 D 的取舍较接近：D 的变更内容更宽，但 A 保持了类型值及 --dry-run 的完整。
